minutes.headline: Select Board transferred On the Rocks' all-alcohol license to a new owner despite a pending violation hearing.
minutes.summary: The board held a public hearing on transferring the Lakefront Avenue all-alcohol license, weighing underage-drinking concerns and the pending violation hearing, then approved the transfer. It also ratified a new Building Commissioner and a part-time police administrative assistant, recommended the fire union contract article for Town Meeting, and heard an Earth Day report and the Town Manager's report before going into executive session.

public_comment.topic: Asked the chair about a reference at the January 17th special meeting to a seven million dollar home sale, and raised tax decreases in one area and police checks on private property.
Spoke in favor of the license applicant, praising the family that ran the Townsend house restaurant.
A solar company representative whose license appearance was not on the agenda asked what to do; the board scheduled him for next week.

what_happened.line: The Select Board voted to grant the transfer of the Lakefront Avenue all-alcohol and common victualler license to a new owner, On the Rocks.
The chair floated holding the hearing after the pending violation hearing; the board instead decided the transfer that night.
The board ratified a new Building Commissioner and a part-time police administrative assistant.
The board voted 4-0 to recommend the fire union contract article (Article 8) to Town Meeting.
A floor amendment at Town Meeting will strike 'residential' from Article 21 section three, so reallocation applies to all taxpayers.

why_it_matters: The license transfer went ahead while a violation hearing on the same establishment was still pending, so that hearing's outcome now bears on a license already held by the new owner.
The fire union contract carries annual raises and other pay changes with stated yearly fiscal impacts, and Town Meeting voters will be asked to approve it as Article 8.
The Article 21 amendment, as described in the minutes, changes whether a reallocation applies to residential taxpayers only or to all taxpayers, which touches how a tax bill is divided.
watch_next: Town Meeting votes on Article 8 (the fire union contract) and the Article 21 amendment.
The solar license applicant is scheduled for 7:10 at next Tuesday's Select Board meeting.
